# GitHub Toolbar Button

> An IntelliJ Platform plugin that adds a main-toolbar button opening the current project's GitHub
> repository page in the default browser, plus commands for the repository's pull requests, issues,
> actions, releases, current branch and pull-request-for-branch pages, and a copy-URL action.
> Written in Kotlin, Apache-2.0, published on the JetBrains Marketplace as plugin 33486.

Requires IntelliJ IDEA 2025.2 or later (build 252) with the bundled Git plugin enabled. Built
against IDEA 2026.2.2 and verified against every released IDE line in the supported range.

The non-trivial logic is deliberately free of IntelliJ dependencies so it stays directly
unit-testable: URL normalization, destination construction and host allowlisting are pure Kotlin,
while only the action layer touches the platform. Host matching against the allowlist is *exact* —
that is what rejects lookalikes such as `evilgithub.com`; GitHub Enterprise is supported by widening
the allowed-host set, never by loosening the comparison.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/pambrose/intellij-github-toolbar-button/blob/master/README.md): what the plugin does, installation, usage, development commands, and CI overview
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/pambrose/intellij-github-toolbar-button/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md): Keep a Changelog format; the section matching the built version becomes the plugin's `changeNotes`
- [RELEASE_NOTES](https://github.com/pambrose/intellij-github-toolbar-button/blob/master/RELEASE_NOTES.md): hand-written prose bodies of the GitHub releases, newest first, one `# vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` section each
- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/pambrose/intellij-github-toolbar-button/blob/master/CLAUDE.md): contributor and agent guidance — the reasoning behind the build, test, coverage and release configuration, including the traps that are easy to reintroduce
- [LICENSE](https://github.com/pambrose/intellij-github-toolbar-button/blob/master/LICENSE): Apache License 2.0

## Source

- [GitHubUrlParser](https://github.com/pambrose/intellij-github-toolbar-button/blob/master/src/main/kotlin/com/pambrose/githubtoolbar/GitHubUrlParser.kt): pure Kotlin; normalizes any Git remote form (https, scp-style `git@`, `ssh://`, `git://`) to `https://host/owner/repo` and strips embedded credentials so tokens never reach the browser
- [GitHubRepoLocator](https://github.com/pambrose/intellij-github-toolbar-button/blob/master/src/main/kotlin/com/pambrose/githubtoolbar/GitHubRepoLocator.kt): wraps git4idea; selects the Git root owning the current file (innermost wins), prefers the `origin` remote, and takes the allowed hosts as a parameter rather than reading settings
- [GitHubDestination](https://github.com/pambrose/intellij-github-toolbar-button/blob/master/src/main/kotlin/com/pambrose/githubtoolbar/GitHubDestination.kt): enum of the non-branch pages the plugin can open
- [GitHubBranchDestination](https://github.com/pambrose/intellij-github-toolbar-button/blob/master/src/main/kotlin/com/pambrose/githubtoolbar/GitHubBranchDestination.kt): enum of the branch pages; percent-encodes the branch but leaves `/` intact, since a slash is ordinary in a branch name and is also GitHub's path separator
- [GitHubUrlAction](https://github.com/pambrose/intellij-github-toolbar-button/blob/master/src/main/kotlin/com/pambrose/githubtoolbar/GitHubUrlAction.kt): the base every URL-producing action extends, and the single place the enabled/visible/tooltip policy is written
- [GitHubHostSettings](https://github.com/pambrose/intellij-github-toolbar-button/blob/master/src/main/kotlin/com/pambrose/githubtoolbar/GitHubHostSettings.kt): application-level persistent state holding extra GitHub Enterprise hosts; always unions in the defaults so a bad entry can fail to add a host but never remove github.com
- [plugin.xml](https://github.com/pambrose/intellij-github-toolbar-button/blob/master/src/main/resources/META-INF/plugin.xml): action and group registration, including both toolbar IDs and the three menus the submenu is contributed to

## Build and release

- [build.gradle.kts](https://github.com/pambrose/intellij-github-toolbar-button/blob/master/build.gradle.kts): IntelliJ Platform Gradle Plugin setup, the test-task adjustments Kotest requires, Kover coverage bounds, and the pinned Plugin Verifier IDE set
- [libs.versions.toml](https://github.com/pambrose/intellij-github-toolbar-button/blob/master/gradle/libs.versions.toml): version catalog; the IDEA entry is the build target, not the supported floor
- [Makefile](https://github.com/pambrose/intellij-github-toolbar-button/blob/master/Makefile): `build`, `tests`, `check`, `verify`, `coverage`, `lint`, `format`, `versions`, `patch-changelog` — note the target is `tests`, not `test`
- [build.yml](https://github.com/pambrose/intellij-github-toolbar-button/blob/master/.github/workflows/build.yml): CI on pushes to master and on pull requests
- [release.yml](https://github.com/pambrose/intellij-github-toolbar-button/blob/master/.github/workflows/release.yml): fires on a `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` tag with no `v` prefix; refuses to publish if the tag disagrees with `gradle.properties`

## Optional

- [Marketplace listing](https://plugins.jetbrains.com/plugin/33486-github-toolbar-button): the published plugin, installable from inside the IDE
- [Releases](https://github.com/pambrose/intellij-github-toolbar-button/releases): packaged ZIPs and release notes
- [Coverage](https://codecov.io/gh/pambrose/intellij-github-toolbar-button): Codecov reports; note it annotates pull requests but cannot block them, since `koverVerify` is the actual gate
